issues.on_page: Local 853,332 (p6) = Statement of Activities charges for services 706,753 + operating grant 1,179 + interest income 82,437 + miscellaneous 62,963 (p2)
issues.issue: Under the extractor rule for county 'Local' lines, charges for services is 82.8% of the line (more than half), so the category should be charges for services/fees (or a split). It was left in other even though the review note cites this evidence. The same report's 911 Emergency Services Local line (detail[57]) was categorized this way.
issues.resolved: 'Local' is a context label: stays other until the context check (CLAUDE.md 2026-11-05 rule)

issues.issue: Going by the p2 charges for services by function (general government 628,711, welfare 24,522), most of the General Fund Local line is charges for services. Probably charges for services/fees rather than other.
Public works charges for services are 30,959 (p2), about 76% of this line, so it is probably charges for services/fees.
Likely records preservation fees (fees of office), but the page doesn't print a breakdown.
